findings.specRef: ТЗ §2 «выбор филиала (автоматически по адресу доставки)»; decisions.md «Выбор филиала по адресу … если точку покрывают зоны разных филиалов — выбирается филиал с меньшей стоимостью доставки, при равенстве — ближайший»
findings.finding: The branch is not chosen automatically from the delivery address. The guest picks a branch by hand before opening the menu, and the address is only used to check that branch. If the cart's branch covers the point, the order stays there even when the API's resolve marks another branch as cheaper or nearer. Another branch is offered only when the current one cannot deliver, and even then the guest has to click to switch. If the cart's branch does not accept delivery, the delivery option is disabled, so the address can't even be entered. The API does not enforce the rule at checkout either. The ranking also compares each zone's base fee and ignores the 'бесплатно от суммы' threshold, so the fee the guest would actually pay is not what gets compared.
findings.evidence: apps/web/lib/checkout.ts:272-278: deliveryDecision returns 'deliverable' for the cart branch whenever it appears among the options, not resolution.best. apps/web/tests/checkout.test.ts:125-127 asserts this ('остаёмся в текущем филиале', while best = b2). apps/web/components/checkout/CheckoutFlow.tsx:171: confirmSwitch runs only when the guest clicks. CheckoutFlow.tsx:105-108: acceptedTypes comes from the cart branch only, so delivery is disabled when that branch has acceptsDelivery=false. apps/web/app/[locale]/menu/page.tsx: the branch comes from a cookie or a manual choice before the menu. apps/api/src/modules/ordering/application/place-order.action.ts:204-216: branchId is taken from the client and only that branch's zones are checked; the resolve rule is never applied. apps/api/src/modules/ordering/domain/delivery-zone.ts:120: rankDeliveryCandidates sorts by the base zone.deliveryFee; resolve does not take the subtotal.
findings.suggestedFix: When the address or point is set, apply resolve.best automatically: move the cart to that branch, re-quote it, and tell the guest (a manual override may stay available). Allow the delivery option regardless of the current branch and resolve the branch by address. Pass the subtotal to /public/delivery/resolve and rank by the effective fee (after freeDeliveryFrom). For the web channel, check in PlaceOrder that branchId is the resolved branch, or record an explicit guest override. Update the unit tests and add an e2e test with overlapping zones of two branches.

findings.specRef: ТЗ §2 «выбор филиала (автоматически по адресу доставки)»; decisions.md «адрес → координаты (геокодер за интерфейсом; на витрине можно поставить точку на карте)»
findings.finding: Geocoding (address → coordinates) is switched off in every deployed build. NEXT_PUBLIC_GEOCODER_URL is baked into the web bundle at build time, but the web Dockerfile doesn't declare it as a build arg and ops/build-env doesn't set it. In staging and production the address search is hidden, and every delivery guest has to find their building on the map by hand. The admin phone order has no geocoding at all. The geocoder is hard-wired to the Nominatim protocol in the browser rather than sitting behind an interface: Yandex and 2GIS are supported as map providers but not as geocoders. It is not documented anywhere, and no e2e test types an address.
findings.evidence: apps/web/lib/geocoder.ts:24-27 (geocoderBaseUrl returns null when the variable is empty). apps/web/.env.example:37 (empty by default). apps/web/Dockerfile:37-49: the ARG list has no NEXT_PUBLIC_GEOCODER_URL, so a build-arg from deploy.yml would be ignored. ops/build-env/production.env and staging.env do not define it. AddressPicker.tsx: when geocoderEnabled is false there is no search button, and hintManual tells the guest to place the pin. apps/admin/src/features/orders/phone/AddressMap.tsx and PhoneOrderPage.tsx: no search or geocoding. grep of docs/: only decisions.md mentions a geocoder; operations.md and infrastructure.md are silent. apps/web/e2e/order-delivery.spec.ts:45 uses clickInsideDeliveryZone.
findings.suggestedFix: Add ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GEOCODER_URL to apps/web/Dockerfile and set a real provider in ops/build-env/*.env. Put geocoding behind a provider interface (Nominatim, Yandex or 2GIS, matching NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_PROVIDER), or add a server-side GeocoderClient adapter, cached and called asynchronously, for /public/delivery/resolve when only address text is given. Add address search to the admin phone order. Document the setting in operations.md. Add an e2e test that goes from a typed address to a branch.

findings.specRef: ТЗ §2 «подтверждается только по факту успешного платежа или колбэка»; Интеграции «вебхуки обрабатываются идемпотентно»; decisions.md «Неоплаченный онлайн-заказ автоматически отменяется… Платёж, пришедший после отмены, автоматически возвращается полностью» и «подтверждение (paid) — колбэк/вебхук или опрос статуса задачей»
findings.finding: The ordering auto-cancel cancels the online payment only in our database. It does not first check the status with the provider and does not cancel the invoice at the provider, so the Kaspi link or Halyk widget can still be paid. A payment cancelled this way is never polled again. If the guest pays near or after the deadline and the provider's webhook is lost, the money is captured but the payment stays 'cancelled' forever: no late-payment refund, no staff alert, and it never appears as received. The payments module's own expiry path does run a final fetchStatus, but it fires on the same deadline, and the ordering auto-cancel skips that check entirely; once the ordering job has cancelled the payment, the payments check exits early. Even when the webhook is only delayed, a guest who paid seconds before the deadline gets a cancelled order and a refund instead of their food.
findings.evidence: apps/api/src/modules/ordering/application/auto-cancel-unpaid-orders.action.ts:35 calls CancelOrder, which calls settle-cancelled-order.ts:41 (payments.cancelPayment). payments/application/payment-status.actions.ts: CancelPayment only changes the local status. payments/domain/payment-gateway.ts:71-86: PaymentGateway has no cancel/void method. place-order.action.ts:383: payment expiresAt = placedAt + awaitingPaymentTimeoutMinutes, the same deadline as the ordering auto-cancel. payments/application/payment-provider.actions.ts:110: CheckPaymentStatus returns when !payment.isOpen(). payments/infrastructure/payment.repository.ts:262: claimForPolling selects only status='pending'. The test ordering-cancellation.int.spec.ts:91 covers only a late webhook that does arrive.
findings.suggestedFix: Before auto-cancelling an order that has an open online payment, enqueue a provider status check and cancel only if the provider reports it unpaid, or delegate expiry to the payments module and react to PaymentCancelled. Add a void/cancel operation to PaymentGateway where the provider supports it. Add a reconciliation job that polls online payments cancelled or failed within the last N hours, feeding the existing late-capture path (cancelled → succeeded → refund). Add integration tests for a paid payment with a lost webhook and for a payment made just before the deadline.

findings.specRef: ТЗ Интеграции «Яндекс.Доставка»; decisions.md «Оплата при получении … Деньги отмечаются полученными (markCollected) при переходе заказа в completed»; инвариант «любое действие, меняющее деньги…»
findings.finding: When an on_receipt (cash/card at the door) order is delivered by a Yandex courier, Yandex is never asked to collect the money: the amount only goes into the free-text claim comment and no payment_on_delivery is sent. Yet when Yandex reports 'delivered', the system completes the order on its own and marks the on_receipt payment as collected (succeeded, PaymentSucceeded). Payments, the receipts report and revenue then show money that no one is required to have collected. Nothing prevents routing on_receipt orders to the external courier.
findings.evidence: apps/api/src/modules/ordering/infrastructure/adapters/yandex/yandex-delivery.payload.ts:75 puts 'Оплата при получении: X' only into the comment; the route_points at lines 95-122 have no payment_on_delivery. application/courier-dispatch.actions.ts:120: collectOnDelivery is computed but only passed on for that comment. application/advance-order-by-courier.action.ts: 'delivered' moves the order to completed as a system actor. application/order-transition-recorder.ts:140-141 and 181-185: completion calls payments.markCollected for every pending on_receipt payment. No guard in courier-requests.ts (RequestCourierDispatch). yandex-delivery.payload.spec.ts only asserts the comment text.
findings.suggestedFix: Either block external courier dispatch for on_receipt orders (keep own couriers or require online payment when the branch routes to Yandex), or implement Yandex payment_on_delivery and mark the money collected only after Yandex confirms it. Never call markCollected automatically when completion comes from the courier-dispatch actor without that confirmation; leave the payment pending for staff or finance to confirm. Add an integration test.

findings.finding: Contactless delivery is sent to Yandex as skip_door_to_door=true, which in Yandex's claims API means 'no door-to-door delivery': the courier does not come up to the apartment. That is the opposite of contactless (leave the order at the door), and it contradicts the note the system itself sends ('оставить у двери и позвонить'). A unit test locks in the wrong value.
findings.evidence: apps/api/src/modules/ordering/infrastructure/adapters/yandex/yandex-delivery.payload.ts:120 (skip_door_to_door: request.contactless). application/courier-dispatch.actions.ts:63 (note 'Бесконтактная доставка: оставить у двери и позвонить'). yandex-delivery.payload.spec.ts:89 (expects skip_door_to_door to be true for contactless).
findings.suggestedFix: Keep door-to-door on (skip_door_to_door=false) for contactless orders. Pass contactless as a leave-at-door instruction in the destination point comment or in the provider's contactless option if the contract has one. Fix the test.

findings.specRef: ТЗ §2 «выбор времени … к определённому времени»; decisions.md «Время: … не раньше чем через deliveryLeadMinutes»; зона доставки имеет срок доставки
findings.finding: Scheduled delivery slots and ASAP availability are computed from deliveryLeadMinutes only and ignore the zone's delivery time (etaMinutes). Yet the ASAP promise uses max(lead, zone ETA). A guest in a 75-minute zone can pick a delivery slot 60 minutes from now, and ASAP is still accepted 60 minutes before closing even though delivery takes 75. Both are promises the restaurant cannot keep.
findings.evidence: apps/api/src/modules/ordering/application/place-order.action.ts:160: scheduleRulesFor(branch, type) runs before the zone is known. domain/scheduling.ts:53 (asapAvailability) and :93 (assertSchedulable) use rules.leadMinutes. domain/order-rules.ts:45: the ETA is max(leadMinutes, zoneEtaMinutes). identity/public/branch-directory.ts:36: default deliveryLeadMinutes is 60. ordering/infrastructure/seed.ts:78: a zone with etaMinutes 75. The /public/branches/:id/order-slots endpoint takes no point or zone.
findings.suggestedFix: For delivery, use max(deliveryLeadMinutes, zone.etaMinutes) as the lead in the slots endpoint (accept a point or zoneId), in assertSchedulable and in asapAvailability. Cover it with tests.

findings.specRef: decisions.md #1 «у каждой точки может быть своё юрлицо и свой мерчант», #8 «Основной провайдер выбирается в настройках (можно по филиалу)»
findings.finding: Payment routing can only map a branch to a provider name. Each provider has a single global set of credentials (one Halyk terminal, one Kaspi merchant). A branch or franchisee with its own merchant or terminal at the same bank cannot be configured, although decisions.md and the routing descriptor say it can.
findings.evidence: apps/api/src/modules/payments/infrastructure/adapters/halyk/halyk.gateway.ts:25 (single key 'payments.halyk' with one terminalId). kaspi/kaspi.gateway.ts:33 (single key 'payments.kaspi'). application/payment-gateway.registry.ts:17-21: branchOverrides is Record<branchId, providerName>. infrastructure/adapters/payment-adapters.ts:22 advertises 'у франчайзи может быть свой мерчант'.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce merchant accounts (settings key per account, e.g. payments.halyk:<accountId>) and route branch → provider + account. Store the account on the payment so that status checks, refunds and webhook verification use the right credentials.

findings.specRef: decisions.md «Использование промокода фиксируется при оформлении и освобождается при отмене до оплаты»
findings.finding: When an on_receipt order is cancelled, its promo code use is never released, even though no money was ever received. The order is marked paid at checkout ('оплата обеспечена'), which sets wasPaid=true, and release happens only when wasPaid is false. The guest's use still counts toward the total and per-phone limits after a cancellation where they paid nothing.
findings.evidence: apps/api/src/modules/ordering/application/place-order.action.ts:399 (markPaid for on_receipt). domain/order.ts:289 (wasPaid = true). application/order-transition-recorder.ts 'paid' case: the usage goes from reserved to used. application/settle-cancelled-order.ts:43: release only if !s.wasPaid. ordering-cancellation.int.spec.ts:183 (the on_receipt cancel test) does not check the promo.
findings.suggestedFix: Release the promo use for cancelled orders with no captured money (the on_receipt payment was pending and has been cancelled), or record in decisions.md that on_receipt counts as paid for promo purposes. Add a test.

findings.specRef: ТЗ «Модель данных»: Order — «итог пересчитывается на сервере при каждом изменении»; роль «Оператор точки — вести заказы»
findings.finding: There is no way to change a placed order: no edit of items, address or time, and no server recalculation of the total. The invariant holds only because orders are immutable. Staff can only cancel (and only from awaiting_payment or accepted, per the status diagram) and re-create the order, which loses the payment and the promo use. decisions.md does not record that orders are immutable after placement.
findings.evidence: apps/api/src/modules/ordering/http/admin/orders.controller.ts: only list, queue, create, transition, reject, cancel, refund and courier endpoints; no PATCH or edit. domain/order.ts: the aggregate has no methods that change items or totals after create().
findings.suggestedFix: Either record the 'orders are immutable after placement' decision in decisions.md, or add an EditOrder action: allowed up to cooking, re-prices via OrderPricing on the server, writes before/after to the audit log, and adjusts payments (a surcharge link, or a partial refund for a reduction).

summary:
Ordering and payments are largely implemented and well covered by tests. All 12 integration test files in ordering and payments pass (109 tests, run with TEST_DATABASE_NAME=aula_audit_ordering_payments), as do 326 unit tests. What is solid:
- The order status machine follows the diagram exactly, and invalid transitions throw.
- Orders are created in draft and moved to awaiting_payment in the same transaction.
- Totals are computed on the server, and order lines are stored as snapshots.
- Refunds work: rejecting a paid order (paid → accepted → cancelled), full refund by default, partial refunds, refunded once all refunds succeed, and automatic refund of late payments.
- Promo codes cover all three types, the limits and branch restriction, and use a row lock.
- Delivery zones do not overlap within a branch (advisory lock).
- Idempotency is in place for checkout, payment creation (unique key and unique provider + external id), webhooks and refunds.
- Halyk, Kaspi and sandbox adapters sit behind PaymentGateway; card data never reaches our server.
- Yandex.Delivery sits behind CourierDispatch.
- Checkout on the storefront is 4 screens.
- The admin panel covers orders, zones, promo codes and payments.

Main gaps:
1. The branch is not chosen automatically by delivery address. The storefront keeps the branch the guest picked by hand and ignores the "cheaper, then nearest" rule, and the API does not enforce it.
2. Address geocoding cannot be enabled in any deployed build (missing Docker build arg and env file entry, no docs, none in the admin phone order), so guests must place a map pin.
3. The unpaid-order auto-cancel cancels the payment only in our database, with no final provider check and no later reconciliation. A lost webhook leaves captured money with no refund.
4. On_receipt orders delivered by Yandex are marked as collected automatically, although Yandex is never asked to collect the money.

Minor: contactless is sent to Yandex with the opposite meaning, scheduled delivery ignores the zone's delivery time, per-branch merchant accounts are not supported, promo use is not released for cancelled on_receipt orders, and there is no order-edit flow.
